Repo: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa, branch feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component.

This is a REWORK round on Step 2 (ZimmSizeChip atom) of the SFCC-236 build — triggered by the VISUAL CHECKPOINT, not by the automated Scorer (which already PASSED this step on rounds 1-2 for correctness/completeness/conformance; Design Fidelity was explicitly left UNVERIFIED both times, and this round closes that gap with a real defect found).

## The defect, confirmed by directly comparing Figma's exported PNGs against the live rendered computed styles

I fetched the actual Figma renders for all 4 states of `.base-size-selector` (node `40003038:125876`) and compared them to the live Storybook computed styles. They do not match — not a colour-shade nuance, a structural box/fill mismatch:

**Figma ground truth (verified via direct PNG export of each individual variant):**
- **Default** (`…125875`): plain text, e.g. "x" — **NO border, NO box at all.**
- **Selected** (`…125874`): text inside a **bordered outline box** — border only, NOT filled. Text stays normal/dark colour, not inverted.
- **Disabled** (`…125873`): plain grey text — **NO border, NO box at all**, same "no box" treatment as Default, just muted colour.
- **Focus** (`…130506`): a bordered box (matching Selected's box) **plus an additional outer focus ring** — the component's Figma frame is 34×34 for this state vs 28×28 for the other three, confirming the ring extends beyond the chip itself.

**Currently shipping (verified via live `getComputedStyle` on the rendered DOM, not a screenshot)** at `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmSizeChip/zimmSizeChip.css.ts`:
```
Default:  border: 1px solid rgb(112,112,112)   background: transparent
Disabled: border: 1px solid rgb(209,209,209)   background: transparent
Selected: border: 1px solid rgb(25,25,25)      background: rgb(25,25,25)   color: white
```

Every state currently gets a border box. Figma gives Default and Disabled **no box at all** — plain text only. Selected should be an **outline-only** box (border present, background transparent, text stays the normal dark colour) — not a solid filled box with inverted white text.

## Required fix — `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmSizeChip/zimmSizeChip.css.ts`

Read the current `resolveBorderColour`, `resolveBackgroundColour`, `resolveTextColour` functions (and their new test file `zimmSizeChip.css.test.ts` from the prior rework round) before changing anything, so you preserve the disabled-wins-over-selected precedence logic already tested there — you are changing WHICH tokens/values each branch resolves to, not the precedence logic itself.

Target behaviour, four states:
1. **Default** (not selected, not disabled): `border: none` (or `borderWidth: 0` / transparent — whichever matches how this recipe already expresses "no border" elsewhere in the codebase; check `zimmColourSwatch.css.ts` or similar for the idiom used when a state has no border), `background: transparent`, text in the normal default text colour.
2. **Selected** (and not disabled): a real border using the correct semantic token (this was already fixed in a prior round to `var(--zimm-color-border-focus)` — keep that token, just make sure `resolveBackgroundColour`'s selected branch now returns `transparent`/no-fill instead of `var(--zimm-color-bg-05)`, since Figma's selected state is outline-only, not filled). Text stays the normal default text colour (do NOT invert to white/inverse — `resolveTextColour`'s selected branch should NOT differ from default's text colour, since Figma shows the same dark text in both the plain and boxed states).
3. **Disabled** (regardless of selected): no border (same as Default — "no box" treatment), background transparent, text in a muted/disabled colour (this part was likely already correct — verify, don't necessarily change, since Figma's disabled swatch IS just muted grey text with no box, matching what "no border" + "muted text colour" already gives you).
4. **Focus**: this is a `_focusVisible` pseudo-state layered via Chakra, not a `selected`/`disabled` boolean flag — check whether the recipe currently renders a REAL border box for the base chip when focus-visible is combined with Default (unselected, unfocused chips have no border, but a focused-but-unselected chip needs to show ITS OWN border, per Figma's Focus variant showing a bordered box). If the current `_focusVisible` implementation only adds an outline (no fill/border box), and Default now has zero border/box, verify that Tab-focusing an unselected chip still produces a visible interactive affordance (per Figma, focus = border box + ring, not just a ring on invisible bounds). You may need `_focusVisible` to also apply the same border used by Selected, in addition to the focus ring itself — read the Figma citation above again (Focus variant shows both an inner bordered box AND an outer ring) before deciding, and use your judgement on the cleanest way to express "focus gets a border+ring even when not selected" in the existing resolver-function shape.

## Update the doc comment
While you're in this file, also fix the stale doc comment flagged in a prior round (around lines 41-46) — it still describes "a text-default fill for the selected state," which was already inaccurate before this round and is now doubly wrong (selected is border-only, not filled at all). Rewrite it to accurately describe the NEW behaviour: default/disabled have no border, selected shows a border-only box, focus adds a border box plus a ring. Keep the existing "not pixel-confirmed against Figma, flag for designer sign-off" framing where genuinely still true — but note that these 4 raw structural states (box vs no-box, filled vs outline) ARE now directly confirmed against the real Figma export at the node IDs cited above, so don't hedge on the shape any more, only on the exact colour token choice if that's still genuinely uncertain.

## Update the test file
`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmSizeChip/zimmSizeChip.css.test.ts` (created in a prior round) tests the OLD behaviour (selected = filled background, per the precedence tests written against the old resolver outputs). Update its assertions to match the new expected outputs (default/disabled = no border, selected = border present + transparent background, text colour only changes for disabled, not for selected). Do NOT change the test file's overall structure or remove the disabled-wins-over-selected precedence coverage — only update the expected VALUES each assertion checks against, since the precedence logic itself isn't changing, only what each branch resolves to.

## Also check and update if needed
`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmSizeChip/index.test.tsx` and `index.stories.tsx` — if either asserts or visually implies the old filled/inverted-text Selected treatment anywhere (e.g. a snapshot, a specific colour assertion, a story control default), update to match. Do NOT touch `zimmSizeChipGroup`'s own files unless the group's tests specifically assert something about the CHIP's visual treatment (as opposed to the group's own layout/keyboard-nav logic, which is unaffected by this visual fix and must not be touched).

## Do NOT touch
- `zimmSizeChipGroup/index.tsx`, its `.css.ts`, or its keyboard-navigation logic — that's all correct and unaffected by this visual fix.
- Any file outside `zimmSizeChip/`.
- `translations/*.json`.
- `theme/components/index.ts` (no new registration needed, the recipe key doesn't change).

## Verify after the fix
```
npx tsc --noEmit
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmSizeChip overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts
npx vitest run overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts
npx eslint overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmSizeChip
node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs
npm run test
```
All must be clean/green. Report exactly what changed in each resolver (old value → new value), confirm the group's files are untouched, and confirm the full suite is still green. Do NOT stage or commit — the visual result gets re-checked in Storybook before this becomes a commit.
